## Decisions (29)

### General

- [ ] **Set price limits per game or per group?** — suggestion: Use tiers per group instead of per-game numbers — e.g. 'impulse' (always worth checking), 'normal', 'only on a real deal' — and keep actual amounts out of this public repo (eBay saved searches / your notes). That replaces the ~130 'price limit not set yet' notes with one rule.
- [ ] **Ace Combat: where does the series fit — and Ace Combat 8 on Xbox Series X or PS5 disc?** — options: Ace Combat 8 on Xbox Series X disc / Ace Combat 8 on PS5 disc / Classics only (04 / 5 / Zero / 6), skip 8 for now — suggestion: Split by era, as your rules already do: classic 04 / 5 / Zero → PS2 PAL discs (they're PlayStation exclusives); 6 → Xbox 360 disc (exclusive, BC, delisted digitally); 7 → keep the Switch cart plan; skip the PSP games. For Ace Combat 8 I'd take the Xbox Series X disc: you don't plan a next PlayStation, while the next Xbox runs the current library — and if Bandai Namco joins Disc-to-Digital the disc gains a digital licence. PS5 is the alternative if you want the modern games next to the PS2 trilogy.

### PC

- [ ] **Should Steam games also become rows (platform “PC”) in the collection?** — suggestion: No — keep Steam in data/annotations.csv. ~1,176 digital games as rows would swamp the physical collection's stats and views; the annotations already lower disc priority where needed.

### PlayStation

- [ ] **Persona 3 Reload: Switch 2 Game-Key Card or PS5 disc?** — options: Switch 2 Game-Key Card / PS5 disc — suggestion: Your call — same reasoning as Metaphor.

- [ ] **Hogwarts Legacy: Switch 1 cart or PS5 disc?** — options: Switch 1 cart / PS5 disc — suggestion: PS5 — the rule says Switch 1 cart, but it's by far the weakest version.
- [ ] **Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: buy on PS5 now, or wait for the rumoured Switch 2 port?** — options: PS5 disc now / Wait for Switch 2 — suggestion: Don't wait for an unannounced port: buy the PS5 disc per the plan — or the Xbox disc if you adopt the `play-anywhere` tie-breaker. If a full Switch 2 cart is announced before you buy, the Switch-first rule takes over.
- [ ] **Like a Dragon / Yakuza: start collecting the series on disc?** — options: Collect on disc (PS5 / PS4) / Stay on Steam — suggestion: Follow 'On Steam → only if cheap': the series stays on Steam; buy a disc only at a really good price, and prefer entries you don't own on Steam. No separate series rule needed.
- [ ] **Could Intergalactic change the “no next PlayStation” decision?** — suggestion: Close this as a duplicate of `ps6-conditions` — Intergalactic is already named there as the kind of exclusive that could matter.
- [ ] **Surplus discs — keep or sell?** — options: Keep as collection pieces / Sell — suggestion: Keep them unless shelf space matters — used PS3 discs bring little when sold and they still play on the PS3. Sell only the ones you'd never replay.
- [ ] **Which optional upgrades are worth buying?** — suggestion: Only at a really good price, and favour upgrades that add content over pure remasters: Ghost of Tsushima DC (Iki Island), TLOU Part II Remastered (No Return mode), FF VII Remake Intergrade (INTERmission). Skip the rest unless very cheap.
- [ ] **Sony stops making discs for new PlayStation games from Jan 2028 — buy PS5 disc targets sooner?** — suggestion: Upcoming 2026–27 PS5 disc targets you're sure about (God of War: Laufey, Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, Persona 4 Revival, FF VII Revelation …): buy at or near launch — reprints stay possible but will likely be small and on demand. Popular released games (Sony first-party, big multiplatform hits) can stay on the cheap-used plan; niche or low-print PS5 discs you want are worth picking up before 2028.
- [ ] **Next PlayStation: under which conditions would it still be relevant?** — options: Stay with 'no next PlayStation' / Reconsider only if Sony brings discs back for new games / Reconsider if the PS6 drive plays PS4/PS5 discs + strong exclusives — suggestion: Keep 'not by default', but write the conditions into the rule: reconsider if Sony brings discs back for new games, or if a PS6 drive plays your PS4/PS5 discs AND there's a reason beyond the drive (exclusives like Intergalactic). A drive only for old discs is not a reason on its own — your PS4/PS5 consoles already play them.

### Xbox

- [ ] **Avowed: sealed code-in-box, Xbox Store, or just Game Pass?** — options: Sealed code-in-box / Xbox Store (Play Anywhere) / Just Game Pass — suggestion: Just Game Pass first (digital-only rule); if you want to keep it, buy on the Xbox Store on sale (Play Anywhere gives the PC version too). A sealed code-in-box only if it's cheaper than the store sale.
- [ ] **South of Midnight: Xbox Store or just Game Pass?** — options: Xbox Store (Play Anywhere) on sale / Just Game Pass — suggestion: Game Pass first; buy on the Xbox Store on sale only if you want to keep / replay it (no physical version exists).
- [ ] **Fable and Halo: Campaign Evolved Xbox discs: buy when really cheap?** — suggestion: Skip unless really cheap — one copy per game, and the PS5 copies (Fable pre-ordered, Halo: Campaign Evolved owned) cover them. The Xbox disc would only add Disc-to-Digital / Play Anywhere.
- [ ] **Gears of War: Reloaded PS5 disc: buy only if very cheap?** — suggestion: Skip unless very cheap: the campaign is already covered by Gears of War: Ultimate Edition (compilations count) and there's no Xbox disc.
- [ ] **Pentiment / Grounded Limited Run discs: what price cap?** — suggestion: Set your cap privately in the eBay saved searches (no prices in this public repo) — roughly the original Limited Run price plus shipping; don't chase listings above it.
- [ ] **Shooter-console expansion — which series to adopt?** — suggestion: Record the series you've started on Xbox as adopted (Metro, Doom, Tom Clancy) and keep the rest (Far Cry, Crysis, Rage, Bulletstorm, TimeSplitters, Doom, Wolfenstein, Borderlands, Sniper Elite, Homefront, Medal of Honor) as suggestions — buy used at a good price.
- [ ] **Fallout / Elder Scrolls on Xbox?** — suggestion: Fallout 3 / New Vegas / 4 on Xbox (backward compatible / Disc-to-Digital, Fallout 4 with Play Anywhere). Skyrim: Switch cart per Switch-first, unless you value the PC copy that the Xbox disc's Play Anywhere licence gives.
- [ ] **Activision/Blizzard suggestions: which to buy, and where?** — suggestion: Keep the existing plans: Crash, Spyro, Tony Hawk, Diablo II/III on Switch (Switch-first); the Xbox suggestions (Diablo IV, Prototype, Singularity, Transformers) are layer 3 — only when cheap. Diablo IV has no Play Anywhere.
- [ ] **Formalise the “series with an Xbox-exclusive entry stays on Xbox” tie-break rule?** — options: Adopt the rule / Don't adopt — suggestion: Don't adopt it as a separate rule — 'Keep a series on one platform' already covers it; decide per series (as with Ace Combat).
- [ ] **Blur: buy the 360 disc for current-hardware playability, or drop it?** — suggestion: Drop it unless very cheap — you own it on PS3 (one copy per game); the 360 disc only matters if you want it playable on current Xbox hardware.
- [ ] **State of Decay 3: still buy on Xbox under the series rule?** — options: Xbox (keep the series together) / Normal platform rules — suggestion: Normal platform rules: it's no longer first-party and also comes to PS5. Wait for a physical announcement, then take the best disc.
- [ ] **Which Tom Clancy games make sense on Xbox — modern discs (Disc-to-Digital) and/or backward-compatible ones digitally?** — options: Modern discs only, offline-capable first / Modern discs + Xbox 360 backward-compatible titles digitally in store sales / Everything incl. original Xbox discs — suggestion: Wildlands on disc first (offline + Disc-to-Digital). The Division 2 / Breakpoint / The Division only very cheap used — they stop working when the servers close. Skip a Siege disc (free-to-play). 360 titles: digitally in a sale per your BC rule, starting with Future Soldier and GRAW 1/2; skip Vegas 1/2 (owned on PS3) unless you want the Xbox versions. Splinter Cell stays skipped unless you change your mind.
- [ ] **Game Pass and the collection: change any rules (first-party Game Pass first, disc later; leaving-Game-Pass watch; tier)?** — options: Keep the rules as they are / Game Pass first, disc later — for Microsoft first-party too / Also watch 'leaving Game Pass' in reviews / Downgrade to Premium — suggestion: Keep the collection rules as they are and use Game Pass as the 'try first, buy later' layer: (1) Microsoft first-party: play it on Game Pass at launch and buy the disc later, used and cheaper, only if you want to keep it — a pre-order is only worth it for collector's / limited editions or when the disc may become scarce. (2) Digital-only third-party games you're playing on Game Pass: buy in the 20%-off window when they leave, only if keeping. (3) Call of Duty is unaffected (no longer day one, you buy the disc anyway). Gears of War: E-Day is your call before 6 Oct: keep the disc pre-order (first print, day one disc) or play on Game Pass and buy a used disc later. Tier: if you mostly play first-party a year after launch anyway, Premium would do; Ultimate only pays off for day-one first-party.
- [ ] **Xbox Play Anywhere: should it change where multiplatform games are bought (Xbox disc instead of PS disc)?** — options: No change / Tie-breaker: Xbox disc when Disc-to-Digital + Play Anywhere / Xbox first for all multiplatform games — suggestion: Add a tie-breaker, not a new default: for a multiplatform game whose Xbox disc converts via Disc-to-Digital AND supports Play Anywhere, buy the Xbox disc instead of the PS disc (unless the PS version has a real extra, e.g. exclusive content). Keep PS discs for PlayStation exclusives and for publishers outside Disc-to-Digital. The reviews would then check Play Anywhere for multiplatform targets and note it — a `play_anywhere = true` field on targets would let the rules engine and the buy plan use it.

Family/shared-console members get access via the sharing account like any digital title. Nothing found yet on offline behaviour or account-recovery edge cases. Program still Insider-only (started 31 Aug 2026); official docs may still change before GA (checked 2026-09-28). · GA 29 Sep 2026: the licence follows the disc — if another account claims it, yours is revoked. Series S / all-digital consoles can't claim. Offline second-account behaviour only suggested by one FAQ (unconfirmed); family sharing / account recovery still not documented. (checked 2026-10-01)
